'''Jasten''' was a young [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ganlihk]]. His parents were [[Elisha Merew]] and [[Locris]]. Jasten was one of the first colonists to make contact with the animals known as [[ludos]].<ref name="COG" />
